summary.text: Mike Kirchner is the Republican nominee for Ohio's 11th Congressional District. According to his campaign website, he is a retired consultant with about 30 years of experience evaluating mostly pension plans, and he lives in Highland Heights.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Kirchner is from Tiffin, Ohio, and graduated from Akron University with a degree in applied mathematics.
He joined the Wyatt Company, known as Towers Watson when he retired, and worked about 30 years as a consultant evaluating mostly pension plans.
The site says he lives in Highland Heights with Audrey and has two sons who live in Pittsburgh and Cincinnati.
